items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Like a Johnny Smith model, they have to maybe wait over a year for the ground thing.

ctx.x: Do you think the guitars they make today are as good as the old ones?

Oh yeah, I think they're pretty good. Well like the guitars that you've got now, you can't buy a guitar like that. No, I know you can't. You can't buy them anymore. You can't buy them, but it takes a long time to get them. If you try to buy a Gibson L5, that might take you over a year before you get the ground thing, you know? You have to order it. They have to put a special order in for it. They don't make it. Like a Johnny Smith model, they have to maybe wait over a year for the ground thing.
